english.title: Carry out an operation in breach of a stop notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person on whom a stop notice under regulation 28(1) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 had been served, without reasonable excuse, carried out an operation **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..) that was specified in the special nature conservation order, on land within a European site, in respect of which a conservation order was in place, when the

(A)_[notice]_
(B)_[consent]_

condition had not been fulfilled, in that **(..SPECIFY HOW CONDITION WAS NOT FULFILLED..)

english.notes:
(i) The stop notice must specify:

(a) details of the operation;
(b) details of the European site to which the notice relates; and (c) the date on which the notice takes effect.

(ii) References to the service of a stop notice are taken to mean (in an appropriate case) the publication and affixing of a notice - see regulation 28(3).

(iii) This offence is not committed by a person served with a stop notice who has fulfilled both the notice condition and the consent condition prior to carrying out the operation. See regulations 28(5), (6) and (7).

(iv) It is a reasonable excuse for a person to carry out an operation if -

(a) the operation was an emergency operation particulars of which (including details of the emergency) were notified to the appropriate nature conservation body as soon as practicable after the commencement of the operation; or
(b) the operation was authorised by a planning permission granted on an application under Part 3 of the TCPA 1990 (control over development).
